Baaki par kuch likha nahi, phir bhi woh kinaare mein aati hain. Parimap mein har bhuja aati hai, likhi ho ya na ho. Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: Bilkul sahi: 6 bhujayein, har ek 5 cm: 6 × 5 = 30 cm. Ab yeh rectangle dekho, 6 cm lamba aur 4 cm chauda. Parimap ek dhaaga hai jo kinaare par chalta hai: pehle 6, phir bagal ki bhuja 4, phir 6, phir 4. Andar ki jagah area hai, woh bilkul alag cheez hai. Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?

director.text: 20 centimetres

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki dhaaga sirf kinaare par chalta hai: 6 + 4 + 6 + 4 = 20 cm. Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam hal karte hain. Maali ke paas 35 m baad hai. Phoolon ki kyari triangle jaisi hai, bhujayein 8 m, 9 m aur 14 m. Kinaare-kinaare ek baar baad lagani hai. Kitni baad bachegi, yeh jaanne se pehle kya nikaalna hoga?

Socho, jeb mein 35 rupaye hain aur ek kitaab khareedni hai: kitne bachenge, yeh kitaab ka daam jaane bina pata nahi chalta. Yahan kitaab ki jagah kyari hai. Kyari ki bhujayein 8 m, 9 m aur 14 m hain, aur maali ke paas 35 m baad hai. Bachi baad jaanne se pehle kya nikaalna hoga?

Sahi jawab. 35 m mein se 31 m baad kyari ke kinaare par lag gayi. Toh poora jawab: maali ke paas 4 m baad bachegi. Ab agla sawaal tumhare liye. Ek park ki chaar bhujayein alag-alag lambai ki hain: 9 m, 6 m, 7 m aur 4 m. Park ke chaaron taraf ek baar ghoomne mein kitne metre chalne padenge?

Is rectangle ki do lambi bhujayein 10 m ki hain, woh lambai hai. Do chhoti bhujayein 6 m ki, woh chaudai. Aamne-saamne ki bhujayein barabar hoti hain. 10 aur 6 ek-ek baar likhe hain, par chakkar lagao toh dono do-do baar milte hain. Ek poora chakkar kitne metre ka hua?

director.text: 32 metre

Sahi jawab. 10 do baar, 6 bhi do baar: 32 m. Ek aur rectangle: 12 m lamba, 5 m chauda. Upar baayein kone se chalo, 12 m aage, phir 5 m neeche. Ab tum saamne wale kone par ho: aadha chakkar. Baaki aadha bhi utna hi lamba hai. Isliye parimap = 2 × (lambai + chaudai). Is rectangle ke liye 2 × (lambai + chaudai) kitna banta hai?

Bilkul sahi. Chaar bhujayein, har ek 6 cm: 4 × 6 = 24 cm, parimap ek doori hai isliye cm. Aao, agla sawaal main aur tum mil ke karenge. Ek notebook ka cover rectangle hai, 24 cm lamba aur 18 cm chauda. Uske kinaare par ek baar tape lagani hai. Poore kinaare ki tape ke liye pehle 24 aur 18 ke saath kya karoge?
